description: Get one record (entry) of a data model by its id, including all its field values and status. A company record (a model with the Company capability) also carries vatId, vatCountry, vatVerifiedAt, vatVerifiedBy and taxExemptReason, null when unset (set_company_vat_id, set_company_vat_verified, set_company_tax_exemption). A product record also carries currencyPrices and variantCurrencyPrices - its prices in additional currencies, minor units, enabled false while that currency is not an additional currency (set_product_currency_prices, set_product_variants); its data holds the default-currency price. Each record carries `url`: its live storefront link, built by the server from the model's urlPattern and the site's public site URL. Use it whenever you link to a record and never build a storefront URL yourself (not from a slug, not from the site address). When url is null or missing, say why instead of guessing: the model has no urlPattern (set it with update_model), the model is not delivered (deliveryAccess none, or it is the login model), the site has no public site URL, or the record - or one it links to - is unpublished.
name: get_record
title: Get record
